items.information:
**ESPAÑOL**
Esta competencia será patrocinada por la marca de cubos Moyu. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA.

**ENGLISH**
This competition will be sponsored by the cube's brand Moyu. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition.

items.name: MLWGS Winter 2020
items.information:
**The venue asks that competitors and spectators only wear soft-soled shoes to protect the gymnasium floor. Please do not wear heels, cleats, or anything similar to the venue.**

A second round of Pyraminx (Top 16) and/or a second round of 3x3x3 One-handed (Top 16) will be held before 3x3x3 Cube Final **only if there is extra time**.

Proceeds for this competition will go toward the Foundation for Sarcoidosis research.

items.information:
This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are required to purchase a day pass to the science center to enter the competition. A day pass is included in the competitor registration fee.

3x3 Blindfolded Round 2 is tentative.

Since this event is in a public area, we will not be silencing the crowd for 3x3 Blindfolded.

items.information:
The main event of the competition is 3x3x3 Cube.
If we have additional time in the schedule before lunch we will add a 3x3x3 One-Handed Final round with a 12 competitor advancement.
If we have time in the schedule in the afternoon we will add additional event finals based on time/registrations.
